name: suggestion-group
purpose: A group of prompts the reader can send without typing (Cloudscape support prompt group, AI Elements Suggestion): support prompts on an empty conversation, follow-up questions after a response, or the choices of a clarifying question. Each prompt is a button; choosing one emits `select` with the click event and the item, and the owner either sends it or places it in the prompt input to edit.
useWhen: The empty state of an assistant, to show what it can do (vertical, up to five).
After a broad response, to narrow it (horizontal chips, up to five, most likely first).
A follow-up question with predefined answers.
avoidWhen: Choices that are a form value → `radio-group` / `radio-cards`.
More than five options → let the reader type; the prompt input stays available.
related: prompt-input` — the open-ended alternative that must stay reachable.
empty-state` — hosts the vertical support prompts before the first message.
chip`, `button` — visual cousins; prompts are their own control because they send text.
bestPractices: Five or fewer, ordered by likelihood.
Write prompts as the reader would ask them, under 72 characters, sentence case, no end punctuation needed for questions you send verbatim.
Disable the group while a response is generating.
Remove follow-ups once the reader sends anything else.

props.name: items
props.doc: Up to five prompts, most likely first.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the group. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Suggested prompts`).

props.name: orientation
props.doc: horizontal` wraps chips in a row (follow-up questions under a response); `vertical` stacks them (support prompts on an empty conversation).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every prompt, while a response is being generated.
